label: baseline

dataset.note: Measured against the live app dataset at capture time; same-data pin = session cookie + canonical route (no legacy ?zone=) + task detail id.

methodology.p75Semantics: lab p75 = 75th percentile across K repeated lab runs of the same route; NOT the field p75 which is across page loads.
methodology.inputChannel: Input.dispatchMouseEvent / dispatchKeyEvent (trusted; in-page synthetic clicks excluded from INP)
methodology.interactionLatency: max Event Timing duration of trusted interactions triggered during the cell (no p98 trimming at lab interaction counts)
